problem: Manage practices shows a Remove button (takes a practice off Practice, keeps its files) next to a trash icon (deletes the downloaded files). The two look alike and read the same. Each proposal shows one consistent way to see and change where a practice is.
references: ref-habits-inactive-dropdown.png: Habits' Inactive habits dropdown, the existing drag-to section
common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity UI proposal board for the Inner Breeze (Inbe) app, landscape 3:2 composition: two identical Android phone screens side by side on a plain very pale blue-grey backdrop. Flat straight-on UI, no perspective, no hands, no photography, no device bezels beyond a thin rounded outline. Above the phones, small navy caption text: "{caption}".
The screen is the "Manage practices" window, opened from the Practice tab. Match the attached screenshots exactly in visual style: Inner Breeze light theme, pale blue surfaces, dark navy text, Noto Sans, rounded cards with thin borders, soft light-blue filled buttons, thin outline icons with one consistent stroke weight. The first screenshot is today's window. The second shows the Habits screen's "Inactive habits (0)" collapsible dropdown row with a chevron; every collapsible section in this design must reuse exactly that dropdown row look.
Problem to solve: today each practice row has a "Remove" button (takes the practice off the Practice tab but keeps its files on the device) and a separate trash icon (deletes the downloaded files). People cannot tell them apart. Show ONE consistent way to see and change where each practice is.
Use exactly these practices and facts. Installed (shown on the Practice tab): "Wim Hof Breathing" (596 KB, comes with the app), "Meditation" (449 KB, comes with the app), "Breathing Patterns" (232 KB, comes with the app). Not installed: "Sun Salutation" (downloaded earlier, its 12 MB is still on this device), "Tai Chi" (not downloaded, 4 MB, paid: "1 Dew" with "10 Dew" struck through, a small "-90%" badge, and "0.001 XMR, about 0.56 USD" under it).
Constraints: English only, short calm labels, crisp correctly spelled text, large touch targets, generous spacing. No trash-can icon next to a Remove button. No search, ratings, categories, store banners, illustrations or features not described here. No lorem ipsum.
{design}

proposals.title: Two dropdowns, drag between them
proposals.summary: Installed and Not installed are habit-style dropdowns. Drag a practice between them; while dragging, a Delete from device target appears for freeing space.
proposals.design: Design: the window holds two collapsible sections in the Inactive-habits dropdown style: "Installed (3)" expanded on top and "Not installed (2)" expanded below. Each practice is a row with a six-dot drag handle on the left, the name, and one quiet line under it: "On this device · 596 KB", "On this device · 12 MB" or "Download · 4 MB". Rows have no buttons; Tai Chi shows its price chip. Left phone: resting state. Right phone: the Sun Salutation row is lifted with a soft shadow mid-drag; the Installed section is highlighted as a drop target with a dashed outline and the hint "Drop to add to Practice", and a red-tinted strip has appeared at the bottom of the window reading "Drop here to delete from device · frees 12 MB". That strip only appears while dragging.

proposals.title: Three shelves by where it is
proposals.summary: Sections say exactly where each practice is: On Practice, On this device only, Not downloaded. Dragging to Not downloaded deletes the files after one question.
proposals.design: Design: three collapsible sections in the Inactive-habits dropdown style, each header with its count and total size: "On Practice (3) · 1.3 MB", "On this device only (1) · 12 MB" and "Not downloaded (1)". Sun Salutation sits in On this device only; Tai Chi sits in Not downloaded with its price chip. Each row: six-dot drag handle, name, size; no buttons. A one-line hint under the title: "Drag a practice to move it." Left phone: resting state. Right phone: Sun Salutation has just been dropped into Not downloaded and its row asks inline: "Delete Sun Salutation's 12 MB? Your progress stays." with two buttons, "Keep" (soft) and "Delete" (filled red).

proposals.title: One menu per practice
proposals.summary: No sections or drag: each row has a single state menu, and choosing a state explains what it does and how much space it uses.
proposals.design: Design: one plain list of the five practices. Each row: name, size, and on the right ONE dropdown pill showing the current state: "On Practice", "On device" or "Not downloaded" with a chevron; Tai Chi's pill reads "Unlock · 1 Dew" under its price. Left phone: resting state with Wim Hof Breathing, Meditation and Breathing Patterns on "On Practice", Sun Salutation on "On device", Tai Chi locked. Right phone: Sun Salutation's menu is open as a small card with three choices, each with a short grey explanation: "On Practice — shown on the Practice tab", "On device — hidden, adds back without a download" (checked), "Not downloaded — frees 12 MB".

proposals.title: Two dropdowns, tap a row
proposals.summary: Installed and Not installed dropdowns like Habits; drag rows between them or tap one to open its single next step, with deleting files shown only where there are files to delete.
proposals.design: Design: two collapsible sections in the Inactive-habits dropdown style: "Installed (3)" and "Not installed (2)". Rows have a six-dot drag handle, name and size line, no buttons. Tapping a row expands it in place into a card. Left phone: resting state. Right phone: the Sun Salutation row in Not installed is expanded: the line "Its 12 MB is still on this device, so it adds back instantly.", one filled button "Add to Practice", and under it a quiet red text link "Delete files · frees 12 MB". The Tai Chi row below stays collapsed with its price chip.
